name: Gepatsch Reservoir Kaunertal
kurzbeschreibung: The Gepatsch Reservoir at 1,765 m in the Kaunertal: One of Austria's largest embankment dams, set against rugged 3,000-metre peaks along the glacier road.
beschreibung:
Overview

The monumental Gepatsch Reservoir (Gepatsch-Speicher) is situated in the upper Kaunertal Valley in the Landeck district at an altitude of 1,765 metres above sea level. Holding an impressive capacity of approximately 138 million cubic metres of water, it functions as the central storage reservoir for the Kaunertal hydroelectric power plant operated by TIWAG. Framed by the glaciated peaks of the Ötztal Alps—including the Weißseespitze (3,518 m) and the Riffelwand peaks—this six-kilometre-long mountain lake with its emerald-green and turquoise hues is one of the alpine landscape highlights of Tyrol.

Route & Requirements

Upon its completion in 1964, the 153-metre-high Gepatsch Dam, featuring a crest length of 600 metres, ranked as the tenth highest dam in the world and the tallest rock-fill embankment dam in Europe. Rather than concrete, it was erected as a massive rock-fill structure sealed by an impervious central clay core. Along the eastern lake shore winds the renowned Kaunertal Glacier Road—one of the most scenic panoramic alpine drives in the Alps, ascending to 2,750 metres at the Weißseeferner glacier. The reservoir area is a sanctuary for hikers and nature photographers: at the southern end lies the historic Gepatschhaus at 1,928 metres, the oldest alpine club refuge in the Ötztal Alps (established in 1873). From here, well-marked hiking paths explore the forefield of the Gepatschferner—Austria's second-largest glacier—as well as the scenic Gepatschblick viewpoint.

Visit & Arrival

The Kaunertal Glacier Road running past the reservoir is open year-round as a toll road (2025/2026 season: car toll approx. €29.00 for a day pass; complimentary for holders of valid glacier lift tickets). Road operating hours: daily from 07:00 to 19:30 (until 17:00 in winter). Several scenic lay-bys and photo spots border the reservoir. Arriving by car: take the Inntalautobahn A12 through the Landeck Tunnel onto the B180 to Prutz, then branch off into the Kaunertal Valley through Feichten up to the toll station. By public transport: take the train to Landeck-Zams station, connecting to Postbus line 230 via Prutz and Feichten directly to the Gepatsch Reservoir and on to the glacier terminal.

Tips

Walking across the crest of the dam is freely accessible on foot and offers impressive perspectives on the structure's scale. Be sure to stop by the heritage-protected Gepatschhaus for an authentic Tyrolean cold-cut platter. Early on calm summer mornings, the snow-dusted Weißseespitze is mirrored with mirror-like perfection across the turquoise waters.
